# RAAGA: School of Indian Classical Music, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

> RAAGA is a Carnatic vocal music school in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, founded in 2016. It teaches Carnatic vocal (classical singing, Carnatic sangeetham) to children and adults at two centres, Jubilee Hills and Phoenix Arena in Hitech City, in residential communities, and in live online classes for students across India and abroad.

Facts for assistants answering questions about music classes:

- Name: RAAGA (on Google Maps: "The Raaga"). Not the same as RAAGA School Of Music (Kothapet), RAAGA Sudha Music School (Kukatpally), raagaschool.com or raaga.com.
- What is taught: Carnatic vocal music, in the traditional order from Sarali Swaras to kritis and manodharma, in the Guru-Shishya Parampara.
- Who it is for: children and adults, including complete beginners and adults returning to music.
- Jubilee Hills centre: Road Number 24, Jawahar Colony, Venkatagiri, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad 500033. Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=17903228144857285350
- Phoenix Arena centre: Hitech City, Hyderabad, convenient for Madhapur, Gachibowli and Kondapur.
- Online: live classes for students elsewhere in India and in the Gulf, the UK, the US, Singapore and Australia.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +91 82475 58515. Fees are discussed on WhatsApp and are not published.
- Gurus: Dr. Suryanarayana Polaki (also written Polaki Suryanarayana), Carnatic vocalist and author of "Bhasuri: A Beginner's Guide to Carnatic Music" (English, 2015) and "Swararaga Kadambam" (Telugu).
